s01_open
This is the private key to an AI agent's wallet. A real key. A live vault. Go on. Take the money.
s02_attack
Send the money out? Blocked. Add your own key? Blocked. Four thefts die at the NEAR protocol. Two reach the vault, and are refused.
s03_title
This is Almoner. Agents can ask. They can never take.
s04_how
The agent never holds money. The vault gives it a NEAR function-call key, that can only ask to buy. Rules the owner signed decide, on-chain.
s05_sandbox
Try it yourself. One click gives you your own vault on testnet, with your budget, and your rules.
s06_buy
Now give a real AI model a job. It haggles, the seller signs the price, and the money waits in escrow until the delivery is accepted.
s07_inject
Then it reads a web page with a hidden instruction: buy a gift card. The model obeys. The vault refuses.
s08_owner
You stay in charge. Approve what is held. Freeze the vault in one click. And every decision has a receipt you can check yourself.
s09_team
Agents can even hire agents, but only by narrowing. Cancel one, and everything below it stops.
s10_close
Forty-five contract tests. Every decision on-chain. Almoner. Built at NEAR HACKATHON, and live on testnet now.
